svg.aria-label: A noisy patch on the left fans out to four different clean patches, each needing an equally ordinary noise draw, and those four average on the right into a smeared grey patch
svg.text: WHAT A SINGLE DENOISER CALL ACTUALLY RETURNS
four of the many clean patches consistent with it
Squared-error training drives the network to the mean of the candidates, not to any one of them. That mean is the blur.
